## Safety and reproducibility

- [ ] I described the scope without claiming broad autonomous repair, AGI, independent agents, or scientific validation without direct evidence.
- [ ] I supplied reproducible test commands and actual results (or explicitly explained why they were not run).
- [ ] I identified whether any model actually ran, its identity/version, and its input/task limits.
- [ ] I distinguished public metadata from reviewed scientific content.
- [ ] I did not add secrets, private datasets, or unlicensed material to commits, logs, or artifacts.
- [ ] I did not execute untrusted external repository code with write credentials.
- [ ] I documented backward-compatibility impact and a rollback approach.
- [ ] I understand that passing CI does not automatically authorize merging; a human maintainer reviews the evidence.
